checks_run.procedure: Read the whole diff since round 10 (BE-Z15) and the full files it touches. Attack the token's issuer tag and its key: disclosure, how the key is created and whether it is immutable, whether the key leaks through responses, audit, logs, triggers, payloads or exports, If-Match ordering, the refusal texts, positions, and every serializer and insert path.
checks_run.command: git diff cde60365..33db1a46 (22 non-delivery files); reads of apps/api/src/modules/automation/versions.ts (whole file), rules.ts:180-300, lifecycle.ts:140-150/395-405/515-525, dry-run.ts, packages/db/migrations/0127_*.sql, 0010_p2_record_guards.sql, 0074 automation_rule_version_guard, packages/db/src/demo/checksum.ts, apps/worker/src/handlers/platform.ts:150-175, audit/routes.ts:60-115; grep of every insertInto/INSERT into automation_rule_version and every selectAll/returningAll of it
checks_run.environment: Repository at HEAD (product tree = 33db1a46)
checks_run.expected: No disclosure through the tag or the key; a token resolves only against the row it was issued by, at the If-Match version; no hidden literal is lost or misplaced; the five mutation properties hold.
checks_run.actual: No defect found. (1) Tag: HMAC-SHA256(per-row 32-byte key, domain||id||row version), truncated to 96 bits (versions.ts:426-431); compared in constant time (sameTag :99); computed only when a hidden literal exists. It is the same for every reader who is not admitted (shown in probe t4) and discloses nothing beyond the row version, which is already served as the ETag. (2) Key: 0127 adds bytea NOT NULL DEFAULT uuid_send(gen_random_uuid())||uuid_send(gen_random_uuid()) (244 random bits; a volatile default, so each existing row gets its own key); length CHECK = 32; a BEFORE UPDATE immutability trigger. Every insert path (versions.ts:687, migrations 0075 and 0117, a worker test) leaves the column to its default; createVersion copies only the content (contentOfRow), never the key. (3) Exposure: the only API serializer is toRuleVersions, an explicit field list (versions.ts:620-655); every caller passes selectAll/returningAll rows (no partial-row casts), and the audit diff is limited to CONTENT_COLUMNS (:795-805). The generic to_jsonb triggers (0010, 0074) neither write nor print the row. The demo checksum covers only demo_seed_record rows, and the demo seed registers no rule versions, so REQ-S18-001 reproducibility is unaffected. The worker reads only v.parameters. The key appears nowhere in apps/web, packages/shared or the OpenAPI (60-source-checks.log). (4) Write path: updateVersion re-checks authorization (loadRuleForWrite), parses with Zod, requires If-Match, locks the row FOR UPDATE and compares the version before resolving tokens (:807-815), then validates; condition_invalid echoes no literal. The UPDATE is guarded by version, and one audit event carries prior and new version. There is no remote I/O. (5) Positions: the issuer (mapLiteralsAt :393-404) and the resolver (literalPositions :381-391) count booleans identically. (6) Texts: the en/ar restricted_token_stale problem texts and the OpenAPI descriptions match the behaviour. The web only tests the pattern for its label (ContentEditor.tsx:48) and never computes a tag. One stale comment: rule-editor-tokens-z14.test.tsx:224 still says '[restricted:3:1]' while its fixtures use the tag form, a test comment with no behavioural effect. (7) Observation, not a finding: a writer can run a dry run on a sample they choose, so a hidden condition 'benefitId eq <token>' tells them whether a uuid they already hold is the hidden one (probe o1: conditionsMet true versus false; no id in any response). That confirms a 122-bit id the writer must already hold, which is the posture D-223 accepted, and it predates BE-Z15.
